title: 2014 Upper Deck Star Rookies #28 Jarvis Landry LSU Tigers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2014 Upper Deck Star Rookies trading card features Jarvis Landry, a football player from LSU Tigers. The card is part of the base set and is a rookie card. It has a card number of 28 and is manufactured by Upper Deck. The card is a sports trading card and is perfect for collectors who are fans of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA). 

The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any collection. It is a must-have for fans of Jarvis Landry and LSU Tigers. This trading card is a great way to commemorate the 2014 season and is a perfect gift for any sports fan.
